status: Curated by the Dalang AI team from public descriptions of wayang kulit and Nusantara folk tales. NOT yet reviewed by a dalang or sanggar: see docs/CULTURAL_REVIEW.md.

rules.guidance: Conflict stays a trick, a chase, a race, a storm or something lost. No war, armies, battles, weapons used to hurt, or killing. Wayang has war epics (Bharatayudha); a children's lakon must not frame its story as one.
No elections, parties, politicians, campaigns or real-world political symbols. Kings and queens of the story world are fine.
No blood, wounds, gore or bodily harm in words or pictures.

Punakawan (Semar, Gareng, Petruk, Bagong) are funny but wise; Semar is a revered elder and must never be called stupid, evil or ugly. Dewa (gods) and court figures are never mocked. Villains (raksasa, buta) are gentle and can change, never humiliated for their looks.
Pictures for ages 5-12: villains look grumpy or silly, not frightening; no bared teeth close-ups, no realistic weapons, a keris only sheathed; nothing sacred (offerings, temple rites) used as a prop.
A known character keeps its canon traits (see canon list). A child may change the plot; the character's nature stays recognisable.
Cultural notes state only well-known facts (archetype, role in the tale). They never invent a sacred meaning, ritual rule, or a claim about a real religion.
The gunungan (kayon) opens and closes the story and marks scene changes. It is never a weapon, a toy fought over, or a joke.

canon.name: Kancil
canon.keep: a small clever mouse deer who wins by wits, not strength

canon.name: Semar
canon.keep: the wise, kind elder of the punakawan; round, humble and deeply respected

canon.name: Buto Ijo
canon.keep: a big green giant (raksasa); in children's tellings a gentle, greedy villain who is outwitted

canon.name: Timun Mas
canon.keep: a brave girl born from a golden cucumber who escapes the giant with magic gifts

canon.name: Malin Kundang
canon.keep: a son who forgets his mother and becomes stone; told as a lesson about kindness to parents

canon.name: Bawang Putih
canon.keep: a kind, patient girl; Bawang Merah is unkind but can learn

canon.name: Sangkuriang
canon.keep: a strong young man who tries to build a lake and a boat in one night (Tangkuban Perahu)

canon.name: Roro Jonggrang
canon.keep: a clever princess and the thousand temples of Prambanan

canon.name: Lutung Kasarung
canon.keep: a heavenly prince in the form of a black langur who helps kind Purbasari

canon.name: Keong Mas
canon.keep: a princess (Candra Kirana) turned into a golden snail, kind to the old woman who finds her

canon.name: Arjuna
canon.keep: a refined (alus) ksatria: calm, polite, skilled; never a brute
